purpose: Restore the project-wide target-discovery architecture as one unified biology program in which common, rare, query-conditioned, relational and regulatory biology are qualified together, and multiple target blocks/teachers/students may coexist when they capture demonstrably different lawful biological information.

historical_alignment.world_model_goal: Predict biologically meaningful multidimensional cellular molecular state, not hidden-gene imputation.
historical_alignment.structured_target_precedent: Historical R5 explicitly described a future target as [z_shared, z_query, eligible specialist state, support, uncertainty].
historical_alignment.single_state_caveat: Historical foundation work also allowed shared/context decomposition if one global state proved insufficient.
historical_alignment.anti_zoo_rule: Historical production work rejected a half-capacity dual-student default and architecture-zoo expansion; multiplicity must be earned by biological non-redundancy, not added by default.

unification_rule.rare_vs_regular: There is no separate rare-biology TD. Rare biology is a regime/property of the same biological target portfolio and the same candidate qualification system.
unification_rule.target_discovery_output: A qualified target portfolio may contain more than one biological block. The objective is not forced selection of one universal winner if multiple blocks capture complementary biology.
unification_rule.portfolio_selection_principle: Retain every block that independently passes its mandatory gates and adds non-redundant lawful biological information without unacceptable shortcut, transfer, support or recoverability failure.

C3_QUERY_MEASURED.rule: Query-conditioned information is retained only if incremental beyond shared state and query-value/identity shortcuts.

C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED.rule: May coexist with C1/C3 if it adds relational information not reducible to them.

C6_SHARED_QUERY_COMPOSITE.interpretation: C6 competes with or operationally combines C1+C3 only if the fusion preserves both blocks and adds efficiency/coherence without biological loss. C6 PASS does not erase the conceptual distinction between shared and query-conditioned biology.

C4_STRUCTURED_COMPOSITE.interpretation: C4 is a possible implementation of a multi-block portfolio, not proof that one monolithic latent should replace specialist blocks.

C5_REGULATORY_SPECIALIST.rule: May coexist with foundation blocks after its own R2/R3 qualification; cannot rescue failure of all foundation biology.

rare_biology_rule.application: Every eligible portfolio block must preserve and truthfully represent both common and rare biology relevant to that block.
rare_biology_rule.specialist_exception: A genuinely rare-specific specialist block may be retained only if it captures reproducible information not representable by the shared/query/relational blocks and passes the same donor/source/operator controls.
rare_biology_rule.stat1_example: STAT1-like rare biology is a qualification/probing program for the unified portfolio, not a separate TD project.

teacher_architecture.principle: Multiple teachers are allowed as evidence-specialized constructors of different target blocks; they must share authenticated cell/donor provenance and cannot vote each other into biological truth.

teachers.T_SHARED_RNA: Rich lawful RNA teacher for shared/global biology.
teachers.T_QUERY: Query-conditioned teacher with rich same-cell evidence, allowed to use the query measurement as teacher evidence while proving contextual information beyond the scalar.
teachers.T_RELATIONAL: Relational teacher only if C2 remains active; constructs neighborhood/relational state under corrected replay semantics.
teachers.T_REGULATORY_MULTIOME: Privileged same-nucleus RNA+ATAC/regulatory teacher for qualified regulatory increments after foundation target/program freeze.
teachers.T_CONTEXT_PRIVILEGED: Optional context/spatial or other privileged teacher for qualified context information when physically measured and biologically non-redundant.

teacher_architecture.shared_core_preference: Where teachers estimate overlapping biology, use a shared biological core plus teacher-specific adapters/heads rather than independent unconstrained latent universes.
teacher_architecture.teacher_private_rule: Information present only in a privileged teacher remains teacher-private or distributional if not reproducibly recoverable from the student's evidence.

student_architecture.principle: Multiple student functions/heads are allowed; separate full student models are justified only if a shared student demonstrably causes interference or cannot represent different evidence/abstention regimes.
student_architecture.default: One full-capacity shared student/online backbone over lawful partial RNA plus qualified observation-operator descriptors, with biologically distinct heads/experts.

students_or_heads.S_QUERY: Predicts q-conditioned local/contextual state from q-safe partial RNA plus query identity.
students_or_heads.S_RELATIONAL: Predicts relational block only if qualified and identifiable from student evidence.
students_or_heads.S_REGULATORY: Predicts RNA-recoverable regulatory component and calibrated uncertainty; does not point-predict teacher-private ATAC realization.
students_or_heads.S_SUPPORT_UNCERTAINTY: Predicts/propagates biological-evidence uncertainty, measurement uncertainty, support and abstention.

separate_student_trigger: stable negative transfer/interference between qualified target blocks under shared-backbone controls
incompatible observation/evidence requirements that cannot be represented by lawful heads/adapters
materially different abstention/support geometry where a shared predictor is scientifically misleading
student_architecture.forbidden_default: Do not create multiple half-capacity students or an architecture zoo merely because multiple target blocks exist.

block_level: student-side recoverability or truthful teacher-private classification
joint_level: no destructive interference when jointly represented
held-donor and held-dataset/technology transfer where lawful
no modality or pathology leakage into foundation selection

outcomes.SINGLE_BLOCK_PORTFOLIO: Only one foundation block qualifies; specialists may still coexist later.
outcomes.MULTI_BLOCK_PORTFOLIO: Two or more complementary foundation blocks qualify and remain separate or jointly implemented.
outcomes.FUSED_IMPLEMENTATION: C6/C4-like fusion qualifies without erasing block-level accountability.
outcomes.SPECIALIST_AUGMENTED_PORTFOLIO: Foundation block(s) plus qualified regulatory/context specialists.

authority_correction.replace_concept: single target winner as mandatory terminal
authority_correction.rule: Owner authority may select one, several, or a fused accountable set of target blocks based on predeclared block and joint qualification. No automatic promotion from survivor count.

non_authority_statement: This contract changes no current replay outcome, opens no protected result, and grants no target, representation, TD60, Stage4 or training authority.
